waypoints.name: White Salmon Road (hairpin) TH / lower White Salmon lodge
waypoints.directions: From Glacier, drive the Mount Baker Highway (SR-542) east about 18 miles to the hairpin switchback at roughly 3,500 ft, about a quarter mile below the ski area's White Salmon Day Lodge, and turn onto White Salmon Road (FS 3075). Parking is very limited and is not allowed on the highway shoulder; do not block the gate. No parking pass is required.

waypoints.name: Mount Shuksan summit pyramid
waypoints.directions: Follow the dirt road up the White Salmon Creek drainage for under a mile, then drop off-trail across White Salmon Creek and climb to the ridgecrest directly opposite the ski area. Follow that crest to the base of the mountain's north side and gain the northwest arete, a long line of loose, runout rock, moderate ice and glacier travel, to the summit.
